summary: Waldo Co., ME lookout: a dismantled tower re-erected on Frye Mountain in 1931, staffed to 1991, moved to Swan Island WMA in 2002 or 2005; relocated tower listed as standing.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firetower.org says the tower was disassembled and moved to Swan Island in 2002, and Wikipedia says it was moved there in 2002; Forest Lookouts says it was removed about 2002 and moved and reassembled in 2005. Both dates are given in the story.

notes_for_editor: The brief's firetower.org page for the Swan Island location (...-at-swan-island-wma/) returned 404 in the cache and live, so it is not cited. The state page does not mention the former lookout, so the link between the Swan Island tower and this lookout rests on Forest Lookouts, Wikipedia and the FFLA list. A Forest Fire Lookout Association Facebook post seen only in search results dates the move to 2005 and describes restoration; it is not cited. Height and design of the 1931 tower are not in the sources read. Access to the original summit is not confirmed.
